text: Removed ips_brasil dataset source state terms permitting redistribution. Removed fuels dataset upstream data combine sources redistribution terms sufficiently clear bundling CRAN. Area-plot examples now use ggplot2::economics_long instead. Every brand scale regenerated one OKLCH specification, every hex code changes except blue.700, blue.800 blue.900. seven scales now share one lightness spine one chroma arc, makes shade number mean visual weight every family: blue.500 orange.500 interchangeable weight. specification lives data-raw/build-ramps.R data-raw/palettes.R checks shipped hex . Removed purple amber scales added stone, warm neutral. seven scales now blue, gray, stone, teal, green, orange red. gold replaces amber accent rather scale: three colors named "light", "mid" "deep", reached ekio_pal("gold")["mid"]. nine-step gold ramp turns brown dark end, top ever gold. three sit lightness rungs scale shades 300, 400 500, deep clears WCAG AA -white surface. gold sequential palette. gray true cool neutral rather blue-tinted one, pale steps moved ramp. gray.500 now clears WCAG AA -white surface 4.75:1, previously sat 2.1:1 failed. color theme_ekio() uses muted text. previous cool, minimal, contrast, muted, muted_warm, binary political categorical palettes removed, along highlight small_group palette groups. full remains available. Diverging palettes return nine colors rather eleven. arms step even shades, halves carry equal weight rung rung. ekio_areaplot(), ekio_barplot() ekio_histogram() longer accept add_zero; ekio_lineplot() ekio_scatterplot() retain argument. Removed verbose argument list_ekio_palettes(). theme_ekio() draws grid lines gray.200 rather gray.300, following ramp’s new spacing.
